query: Which ASR correction, domain-adaptation, and annotation-to-model mapping steps most effectively reduce transcription and domain mismatch bias?

response.query: Which ASR correction, domain-adaptation, and annotation-to-model mapping steps most effectively reduce transcription and domain mismatch bias?
response.answer: Context-Guided Active Domain Adaptation (CGDA) effectively reduces transcription and domain mismatch bias. It blends target domain data with active learning. This method also enhances model generalization.
